description:
Run Python with the selected runtime and Locus SDK. `locus`, `project`, and `workspace_ref` are injected into an async body; top-level await works. For action=run, readonly=true requires the body and every nested SDK/tool call to be observation-only.

Observe with await locus.get_unity_editor_status(project=project): inspect status.ready, status.safe_mode, status.is_crashed, status.editor_log_path, and status.blocking_dialog. Use unity_get_console_log for compiler/crash diagnostics. When recovery is authorized and needed, await locus.ensure_unity_editor(...) or restart_unity_editor(...), passing project=project, mode="interactive" or "headless", wait_until="ready"; inspect the returned status and forced_process_ids.

Use action=help topic=unity for recovery details, or agents/sessions/tools/callbacks for other SDK workflows. Pass workspace_ref to checkout-scoped tool calls and Agent runs. Task APIs are built in: await locus.list_tasks() lists only current-session tasks; get_task_status(id), wait_task(id, timeout=30), cancel_task(id), resume_task(id, message=...) and send_message(id, text) use short task ids or assigned subagent names. Resume supports failed/cancelled subagents only. Messages to finished subagents automatically continue their existing conversation; children can message parent. Task-control-only scripts use readonly=true to avoid waiting for the workspace mutation lock. No tool loading is needed. Use action=help topic=tasks for details.
